title: Research: rule out a shared external query saving
body:
## Summary

Prove that any number of disjoint indicator terms retain their full actual-reader bill after one common external query perturbation and its compensation are charged. The statement holds over every coefficient field and every finite even binary-orthonormal partition, with arbitrary seed values/support and arm coefficients.

```text
q_j = a_j + alpha_j c; compensator = (c, -sum_j alpha_j a_j)
old query zeros -> binary cancellation bits -> support-domination
expanded identity -> total reader tariff >= sum_j group_size(a_j)
```

The useful new domain is k>=3 targets and k+1 queries with one external direction. The initial pair lift was already covered by [PR3414](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3414) at `7b698dc958695d0a788327ddf8866b10a59e4c37`; its full proof was read before synthesis and that duplicate scope is explicitly rejected. [PR3463](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3463) treats pair-span queries. Neither predecessor covers this arbitrary-k external-star domain. The theorem addresses this one architecture, not general four-query pair realizations or arbitrary triple recodings.

Only `research/p112-external-star-reader-floor/` changes. It contains the universal proof, two different support-transfer implementations, exact source pins, the unchanged attributed PR3370 fixture, receipt, optimized CLI controls and bounded open questions. Credit stays with Tekalign/PR3370, Philippe Van Velzen/PR3345, the immediate predecessor proofs and the retained P112 lineage.

## Evidence

- **Before:** one external direction was open beyond the two-target scope; the original pair proposal was already covered. **After:** binary cancellation bits prove the no-saving result for arbitrary k under the explicit common-perturbation contract. A four-independent-query external example attains its three-target bill of 24 with zero arm coefficients allowed.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay passes all three commands. Primary checks cover 50,176 expanded-I224 entries, 12,492 local finite-field states, 4,960 external triple fixtures, every k from 1 through 32, and 12,544 exact rational/GF4 operator entries. Fixture minima are not seed optima.
- The separate implementation uses binary support domination and explicit row-array elimination, importing none of the primary arithmetic. It checks 3,500 rational local states, all k>=3, non-P112 geometry and invalid partitions.
- Optimized Python 3.15 checks and five actual CLI corruptions pass. All three Git-free optimized commands ran at scientific commit `3b7a1d84bad677a9a276aaa0d7c1ece7663b24f6`. Final head `56afaf4f884f3978fc7c8709b1c7ee499ee70b33` only separates public comparison receipts from publication-ancestry pins and explains that distinction. Measured hashes confirm unchanged checkers, live input, fixture, receipt, manifest and mathematical proof text. The final exact committed-byte/source-history gate passes 12 files. Source compilation and diff checks pass.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-external-star-reader-floor
```

The original source-history gate rejected pending comparison proof heads as nonancestors. They are not replay or proof dependencies and remain recorded with exact public heads/blob/SHA receipts in `comparison_sources`, rather than declared Git ancestry pins. No predecessor result is assumed.

Use an existing private external TMPDIR for disposable control copies. Source baseline and submission refresh are canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. No supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier claim. Native acquisition/coefficients/frames/restoration, hosting, stock, precision, all-size/compiler and outer transfer remain unproved. Lean, Docker, full selected cold replay and hosted CI were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

An isolated research package with one declared live input. Existing verifiers, selected records and frozen predecessor bytes are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** Research
